integrity: Six complete explanatory and review files and an independently rerunnable high-precision moment checker accompany the mathematical statement. No independent audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Statement concerns the normalized exponential-age mixture of free nonlinear similarity packets, not arbitrary nonlinear PDE dynamics with a reset-source term.
Kurtosis identifies the porous-medium exponent at ideal population-moment accuracy; it does not separately identify reset rate or transport scale.
At the Gaussian fourth-moment crossing the sixth cumulant is nonzero; no claim of Gaussian distribution.
Complete claim-level access to one later related paper was unavailable; scientific priority remains qualified.
title: An exact kurtosis identifiability threshold for renewal-aged porous-medium packets
